semiconductor_relevance: High — Xi'an LeadMEMS Sci&Tech Co., Ltd. specializes in MEMS solutions, which are integral to various semiconductor applications.
summary: Xi'an LeadMEMS Sci&Tech Co., Ltd. is a technology innovation enterprise that provides integrated microelectromechanical systems (MEMS) solutions. The company operates a comprehensive 8-inch MEMS production line, offering services from device design to mass production, catering to research institutes and innovative enterprises.

regional_presence.China: The company is based in Xi'an, China, and serves various domestic research institutes and universities.
